description: Find restaurants and bars by city, cuisine, opening time or features. Filters are HARD, prefer_* and avoid are SOFT (rank only), and query is ONE keyword. Each result has slug, capabilities, open_now and distance_km; a place inside a destination is not here, use destination_listings.

accepts_reservations.description: Set true to require venues that take reservations (a booking link or a live booking tool); omit otherwise.

at.description: A local time (20:00 or 8pm); requires open_on.

avoid.description: SOFT: venues matching these cuisine/neighbourhood tokens rank LOWER; not dropped.

city.description: HARD filter: only venues in this city (case-insensitive); call list_cities for the exact values this directory knows.

cuisine.description: HARD filter: only venues with this cuisine (case-insensitive exact match; a miss's reason lists the valid values).

cursor.description: Number of items to skip; pass `next_cursor` from the previous page.

facets.description: HARD experiential-facet filter: each token is '<facet_type>:<value>' (e.g. 'dietary:vegetarian', 'vibe:romantic'); types are vibe, good_for, not_good_for, feature, noise_level, view, dress_code, meal_period, cuisine, dietary, accessibility. A venue must match every facet_type given (values OR within a type); a miss EXCLUDES it.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

near.description: HARD filter: only venues within radius_km of this 'latitude,longitude' point, nearest first, each with a distance_km; venues with no coordinates are excluded.

neighbourhood.description: HARD filter: only venues in this neighbourhood (case-insensitive exact match; a miss's reason lists the valid values).

open_now.description: Set true = open at this moment, not later today (venue local time); for tonight use open_on=today with at; omit otherwise.

open_on.description: HARD filter: only venues open on this weekday, or today/tomorrow in the venue's own timezone (optionally at 'at'); for tonight use open_on=today with at. Venues with no published hours are excluded.

prefer_cuisine.description: SOFT: venues of these cuisines rank higher; non-matches are NOT dropped.

prefer_facets.description: SOFT experiential-facet preference, same '<facet_type>:<value>' tokens as facets: a venue that declares them ranks higher but is NEVER dropped.

prefer_neighbourhood.description: SOFT: venues in these neighbourhoods rank higher; non-matches are NOT dropped.

price_band.description: HARD filter: only venues in this price band, e.g. '$$'.

query.description: ONE keyword: a name or cuisine word; for a dish use search_menus. Matched in name, description, cuisine, neighbourhood, city or alternate names; omit to list all.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km around 'near' (default applied when omitted).

name: search_venues

outputSchema.description: The Yenta response envelope: a status, the answer in `item` or `items`, and the approved content revision it was read from.

title: Search venues
